name: November
theme: Shaadi Season (and a Very Black Friday)
objective: Sell group packs into the wedding season; bring lapsed clients back before the baraat; one loud 11-hour pack day on 11.11; and a Black Friday that moves renewals onto long plans with a mystery bonus instead of a deeper price.
strategy:
Shaadi Season (and a Very Black Friday).

Commercial job: Sell group packs into the wedding season; bring lapsed clients back before the baraat; one loud 11-hour pack day on 11.11; and a Black Friday that moves renewals onto long plans with a mystery bonus instead of a deeper price.

Newcomer: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too) (“Four of you, one wedding, zero excuses. Squad rates inside.”). November–December is shaadi season: brides, bridesmaids and families are motivated and arrive in groups. A group rate recruits several newcomers in one conversation, and the hosted class is time we already have, not cash.

Lapsed: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (Come Back Before the Baraat) (“Shaadi mein zaroor aana. And to class before that.”). An event with a date beats a generic reminder, and the wedding season is the date. The socks and the class cost little and give a returner a reason to post.

Spot: 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex (“11.11. Eleven hours. Treat yourself, not your ex.”). Singles’ Day is now a shopping date in India. A one-day pack price brings in fence-sitters and members topping up, at a discount that never reaches memberships.

Renewal: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds) (“Black Friday, but every box is a winner. We checked.”). Black Friday discounts train members to wait. A mystery bonus keeps the cash discount at the standard ladder (10/15/20%) and makes opening the box the content.
notes: Build: 46 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹5.1L; 50 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹11.8L; 22 winbacks = ₹2.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.9L. Offers carry ₹13.8L (64% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

offers.name: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds)
offers.headline: Black Friday, but every box is a winner. We checked.
offers.benefit: Fri 26–Mon 29 Nov: 3 Months at 10% (₹52,070 / ₹37,989), 6 Months at 15% (₹96,658 / ₹69,883) or Annual at 20% (₹1,75,560 / ₹1,24,992), then pick a sealed black box.
